narrative.northStar: A focused workspace for running and directing coding agents.
narrative.overview:
Floq keeps agent sessions, projects, tasks, and terminal work in one focused desktop workspace. Its visual system favors clear hierarchy, stable compact navigation, and rounded functional surfaces. Dark mode is OLED black with neutral Apple charcoal; the light mode uses cool pearl and ink. Flowless orange marks primary actions and keyboard focus.

Native Mica, Acrylic, or vibrancy supplies the desktop backdrop. Floq-owned CSS surfaces add restrained translucency and bounded blur where needed; dense data, terminal output, and code remain crisp and opaque.
keyCharacteristics: OLED black and neutral charcoal in dark mode; cool pearl and ink in light mode.
Orange is reserved for primary actions and useful focus emphasis.
Rounded workspaces, dialogs, fields, and compact navigation rows.
Native desktop material behind bounded, translucent Floq surfaces.

rules.name: One Selection Signal
rules.body: Active navigation uses one neutral capsule; no orange rail or stacked outline.

rules.name: Native Material
rules.body: Use native desktop material behind bounded translucent controls; broad shells use static translucent surfaces.

rules.name: Content Stays Readable
rules.body: Keep terminal output and code opaque; avoid blur behind dense content.

dos: Do use Geist Variable and Geist Mono for interface and terminal/data text.
Do preserve the compact project tree geometry and reserved utility-action slots.
Do keep a visible keyboard focus ring and respect Solid and OS reduced-transparency fallbacks.
donts: Don't add colored rails to selected navigation rows.
Don't put broad blur layers behind terminal content.
Don't add ambient animation behind working surfaces.
